title: Samplekids

content:
A port of the Critter and Guitari patch Children of Sample for Orac. Instead of using the aux button to navigate the patch, there are now 3 pages. Main, Edit, and Record. 

The main page contains the global start and length controls as well as the controls for the delay. 

The edit page will give access to individual parameters for every key to adjust speed, volume, start point, and length. 

The record page is where you will record the sample to be acted upon. Click the aux while on the page to arm recording and as soon as a volume threshold is crossed, recording begins. There is a maximum length of 10 seconds recording time and will stop automatically. If you are recording a sample shorter then 10 seconds, change the page to either Edit or Main to stop recording. 

Additionally, outside samples can be loaded on the record page. The sample selection works similarly to OracLoops and Loopy. You are able to select a directory, sample, and set the volume. When using outside samples, you are not constrained by the 10 second time limit.
